title: Ban'ethil Hollow

[[File:Ban'ethil Hollow.jpg|thumb|Ban'ethil Hollow]]

'''Ban'ethil Hollow''' is a small ravine in [[Teldrassil]], located south of the road that leads from [[Dolanaar]] to [[Darnassus]]. The hollow is filled with many [[hostile]] [[furbolg]]s who will occasionally ambush adventurers on the road. It is wise to exercise caution when traveling.  The [[Ban'ethil Barrow Den]] is located in the back of the hollow.
